C0946.title: Guangdong Cracked the Nation's Largest WeChat Red Envelope Gambling Case Involving 120 Million Yuan
C0946.summary: In 2015, Fang X and Fang X and others used mobile WeChat to set up multiple gambling groups, organizing gambling through red envelope grabbing, bullfighting, and Pai Gow. The groups had up to 2,480 nicknames, with daily gambling amounts exceeding 800,000 yuan, and the total amount involved exceeded 120 million yuan.
